key_driver_codes: Heart Transplant or Implant of Heart Assist System without MCC
Chimeric Antigen Receptor (CAR) T-cell and Other Immunotherapies

pattern.pattern_details: This segment is being driven by a small number of catastrophic and specialty inpatient cases, not by a broad change in utilization. The standout cases include heart transplant or heart assist system admissions, CAR-T and other immunotherapy, and smaller one-off bowel, spinal, respiratory, and cellulitis cases. These episodes are too infrequent to treat as a stable trend without case-level validation.
pattern.why_it_matters: One or two catastrophic admissions can create multimillion-dollar swings and can easily be mistaken for a persistent market problem.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Send these cases to focused clinical and data-quality review to confirm severity, coding, and claim handling before using them to change broader management or pricing strategy.
pattern.validation_reason: The pattern is dominated by low-baseline, small-number catastrophic cases that require case-level validation before extrapolation.
evidence_summary: CO heart transplant or heart assist system cases added +$1.5M from 1 admission.
CO CAR-T and other immunotherapy added +$0.9M from 1 admission.
The remaining +$0.4M is spread across smaller one-off bowel, spinal, respiratory, and cellulitis cases in MO, WI, UNATTRIBUTED, and CO.
